summary.content:
Today's selection covers 106 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 24 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: We tried Google’s AI glasses and they’re almost there
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Former US execs plead guilty to aiding tech support scammers
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, The Verge, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 41 articles published in the last 24 hours
